payload.claim: The fourth acceptance criterion requires that on a GitError (no `.saffron` at `base_sha`), the printed line names the failed read of `done/` at `base_sha`. `test_a_spec_whose_retired_first_cannot_be_checked_exits_as_a_setup_failure` (tests/test_cli.py:3358-3359) only asserts `out.startswith("SY-9")` and `"not retired" not in out`; it never checks that the message actually names the failed read or `base_sha`. Replacing the print body with a generic message that still starts with the spec id, still avoids the words "not retired", and still returns 2 (e.g. `print(f"{spec.id:<10} refused: setup error ({broke})")`) keeps this test and every other test in the suite green while the criterion's claim that the line 'names the failed read of done/ at base_sha' goes unmet.
